title: The Fenchel Game of Underdamped Langevin Dynamics: Insights into Accelerated Convergence
summary: For $(Q_t,P_t)$ governed by suitably damped underdamped Langevin dynamics, we quantify the convergence in KL divergence of the positional marginal to a $σ$-strongly log-concave target $π(dq) = \frac{1}{Z}e^{-V(q)}dq$ as \begin{align*} \operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_t) \| π) \leq e^{-\sqrtσ t}\operatorname{KL}(\operatorname{Law}(Q_{0}, P_{0})\, \|\, Π_0), \end{align*} where $Π_0$ denotes an appropriately selected reference measure.
